title: Citation auditor detect stage implementation
description: Implement the detect stage of the citation auditor. The implementation will revive Bun + TypeScript skill scripts under `skills/audit-citations/scripts/cli.ts`, with a bun.lock and package.json. Detect will walk target files and emit JSON. This approach is preferred because the original clc-dvqh skill shipped that way.
acceptance_criteria: bun ./cli.ts detect accepts file paths. Extracts BFH, BMF, EuGH, and GDPR citation patterns. Emits a JSON array of detected citations to stdout. Exit code 0 on success, 1 on error.

metadata.intent: Deliver the first stage of the citation auditor pipeline: pattern-based detection of legal citations in source files.
